Remark
[Irreducible decomposition of $ abla ^3v$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0130, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0131 1. ch29:29.42\group The $Q$ Invariant

The irreducible decomposition of $ abla ^3v$ gives the same trace-free tensor as the symmetrized construction and makes the identity in Lemma 29.40 orthogonal.
